name: ai-brainstorm
description: Multi-agent cross-model tooling for Claude Code. Two skills: `ai-brainstorm` runs an adversarial lead + judges debate that produces one battle-tested plan; `ai-review` has a different-model judge review your uncommitted changes round by round while you fix or rebut its findings, until the change is clean — with a lite mode for a fast, low-token, file-free pre-commit pass.
